build_imagenet_pi_dataset_builder: build a tensorflow datasets builder for imagenet_pi with annotator labels and confidences
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with image, clean_label, annotator_labels, annotator_confidences, and file_name features
generate_train_examples: generate training examples from nested tar archives with annotator labels and confidences
